title: To Copy or Not to Copy: Copying Is Easier to Induce Than Recall

bias_targets.methodology: Defining and evaluating model responses across two distinct prompt topologies (Query-First and Context-First) to isolate and remove the confounding effects of primacy and recency biases when models process contextual information.

Accounting for entity popularity by stratifying dataset samples into 'High' and 'Low' tiers based on historical Wikipedia pageview statistics (2000–2025) to control for the model's varying familiarity with different facts.

Applying strict constraints (12–16 words) during the generation of synthetic relevant and irrelevant contexts using an LLM API to prevent text length from confounding the model's arbitration between context and parametric memory.
